target: same full-rank four-direction exact projected energies as stretched molecular stress study
rank_policy_allocation: When measured full-rank margin unresolved and targeting, spend half rounded up on worst overlap margin and remainder on corrected Ritz variance; all on margin if SE qualifies. Uniform fallback for deterministic or unavailable functional. Otherwise corrected Ritz targeting.
margin_rule: All three normalized weak-mode margins (absolute tau_s, relative lambda_max, lambda_max/max_condition) minus covariance-aware Gaussian radii must be strictly positive; include diagonal-normalization derivative and largest-mode derivative, pay Bonferroni for 3 comparisons x scheduled looks. Require full live and retained rank and two consecutive separated looks. Heuristic, not a finite-sample bound.
development: Seed 501 only for two rank-guard feasibility runs; toy finite differences, deterministic and failure-path tests. Prior stress data used for construction, never counted as fresh outcomes.
seed_rule: SeedSequence([seed_root, case_index, replica, stream]).generate_state(1,uint64); measurement stream 0, terminal bootstrap stream 1. Width arm uses SeedSequence([bootstrap_seed, look_index]) for each width assessment. Identical initial pilot across arms; rank-margin allocation is a different trajectory.

primary_criteria.interpretation: descriptive feasibility bar, not a hypothesis test. True stop is target_met and |error| <=1.6 mHa; false stop is target_met and |error|>1.6 mHa; failure/exhaustion is never a true stop.

secondary: All-attempt success, false stops, exhaustion, failure; rank at terminal, actual error on returned point, RMSE, bias, all-attempt shot costs, total measured/attempted bootstrap solves, per-look guard diagnostics. Coverage of terminal delta and bootstrap intervals at their actual family-adjusted 95% level, unconditional and conditional on stopping. Fixed-budget arm has no early stop, family=1, report terminal accuracy and never credit it as an adaptive stop. Paired differences descriptive.
failure_policy: All attempts, shots, and completed solves counted; failed bootstrap width cannot pass; at exhaustion report diagnostic terminal interval but not precision stop, failed interval uncovered. Unexpected errors abort and preserve checkpoints; never selectively retry.
limitations: Engineered cutoff on the same stretched frozen-core four-direction banks, certified diagonal CV only, ideal QWC shots. Rank guard's data-derived asymptotic margins and fixed-final-histogram spread are heuristic; no chemical accuracy, full-basis, hardware, or anytime-valid guarantee. Small 16 outer and inner samples; no claim of generalization or formal statistical superiority.
